local Character
local Humanoid
local Animator
local RunTrack
local MoveConnection

local function SetupCharacter(char)
    Character = char
    Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not Animator then
        Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        Animator.Parent = Humanoid
    end

            RunTrack:Stop(0)
            RunTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    Animation.AnimationId = ANIMATION_ID

    RunTrack = Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
    RunTrack.Looped = true

    RunTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

                    RunTrack:Stop(0.15)
                end
            end

        end

        Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)

            RunTrack:Stop(0.15)
        end
    end
end)

    SetupCharacter(char)

local startPos

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragInput = input
    end
end)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- === Sound object ===
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.Name = "PlayerSound"
sound.Volume = 0.7
sound.Parent = workspace

-- === Queue & state ===
local queue = {}          -- list of sound IDs (strings)
local currentIndex = 0
local isPlaying = false
local isLooping = false
local isShuffled = false

-- helper: update the track label
local function updateTrackLabel()
    local total = #queue
    if total > 0 then
        trackLabel.Text = currentIndex .. "/" .. total
    else
        trackLabel.Text = "0/0"
    end
end

-- play a track by index
local function playTrack(index)
    if index < 1 or index > #queue then
        sound:Stop()
        isPlaying = false
        playButton.Text = "▶"
        updateTrackLabel()
        return
    end
    currentIndex = index
    local id = queue[currentIndex]
    if not string.find(id, "rbxassetid://") then
        id = "rbxassetid://" .. id
    end
    sound.SoundId = id
    sound:Stop()
    sound:Play()
    isPlaying = true
    playButton.Text = "⏸"
    updateTrackLabel()
end

-- next track (with loop and shuffle awareness)
local function nextTrack()
    if #queue == 0 then return end
    if isShuffled then
        -- pick random remaining? simple: shuffle and go to next
        local newIdx = math.random(1, #queue)
        playTrack(newIdx)
    else
        local nextIdx = currentIndex + 1
        if nextIdx > #queue then
            if isLooping then
                nextIdx = 1
            else
                sound:Stop()
                isPlaying = false
                playButton.Text = "▶"
                updateTrackLabel()
                return
            end
        end
        playTrack(nextIdx)
    end
end

local function prevTrack()
    if #queue == 0 then return end
    local prevIdx = currentIndex - 1
    if prevIdx < 1 then
        if isLooping then
            prevIdx = #queue
        else
            return
        end
    end
    playTrack(prevIdx)
end

-- when track ends -> auto next
sound.Ended:Connect(function()
    if isPlaying then
        nextTrack()
    end
end)

    if #queue == 0 then
        -- if nothing in queue, try to parse input
        local input = textBox.Text

        local ids = {}

local function selectTab(order)
    activeTab = order
    for i, data in pairs(tabList) do
        local selected = (i == order)
        data.indicator.Visible = selected
        TweenService:Create(data.button, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.muted
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0

    addCorner(knob, 6)

    local function setState(enabled)
        stateLabel.Text = enabled and "ON" or "OFF"
        stateLabel.TextColor3 = enabled and Theme.accentBright or Theme.muted
        TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Theme.cardHover or Theme.card}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(switch, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Theme.accentDark or Theme.off}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

            BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Theme.knobOn or Theme.muted

        Toggles[toggleKey] = not Toggles[toggleKey]
        setState(Toggles[toggleKey])
        if callback then callback(Toggles[toggleKey]) end
    end)
    return button

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (myChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if Toggles.PassTarget then
                    if dist > maxDist then maxDist = dist; selectedPlayer = p end
                else
                    if dist < maxDist then maxDist = dist; selectedPlayer = p end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return selectedPlayer
end

local isPassing = false
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if (not Toggles.AutoPass and not Toggles.CrazyFastPass and not Toggles.InvisPass) or isPassing then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    local bombInHand = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not bombInHand then return end

    local timer = bombInHand:FindFirstChild("Time") or bombInHand:FindFirstChild("Timer") or char:FindFirstChild("BombTimer")
    local triggerLimit = (Toggles.InstantPass or Toggles.CrazyFastPass or Toggles.InvisPass) and 999 or 3
    local timeLeft = (timer and typeof(timer.Value) == "number") and timer.Value or 3

    if timeLeft <= triggerLimit then
        local target = getTargetPlayer()
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            isPassing = true
            local originalCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            local targetHRP = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart

            if Toggles.InvisPass then setCharacterVisibility(false) end

            local angle = 0
            local startTime = tick()
            local speedMultiplier = (Toggles.CrazyFastPass or Toggles.FastOrbit) and 1.5 or 0.4

            while char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") and (tick() - startTime < 3.5) do
                if targetHRP and targetHRP.Parent then
                    angle = angle + speedMultiplier
                    local distanceOffset = Toggles.CrazyFastPass and 0.5 or 1.5
                    local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distanceOffset, 0, math.sin(angle) * distanceOffset)
                    char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetHRP.Position + offset, targetHRP.Position)
                    if Toggles.CrazyFastPass then
                        char.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(500, 500, 500)
                    end
                else
                    break
                end
                task.wait()
            end

            char.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = originalCFrame
            if Toggles.InvisPass then setCharacterVisibility(true) end
            task.wait(0.3)
            isPassing = false
        end
    end
end)
